description: This file defines the VacancyAPI class, which implements CRUD operations for Vacancy entities within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting vacancy records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: VacancyAPI
classes.description: The VacancyAPI class provides RESTful API endpoints to manage Vacancy entities, including CRUD operations, input validation, and detailed API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Vacancy by ID, throws exception if not found, returns VacancyDetailedModel encapsulated in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all vacancies with filtering, sorting, and pagination support; returns a collection of models with metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Vacancy record after validating input parameters, sets default and input data, and returns the created Vacancy in detailed form.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Populates a Vacancy entity with data received from request, validating job title and employee IDs, setting attributes accordingly.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, including ensuring the ID is accessible and valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for filtering parameters used in list endpoints.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which model class to instantiate based on request query parameter.

methods.name: getModelClassParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the 'model' query parameter to ensure it matches allowed types.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Vacancy record identified by ID; validates existence, updates attributes, and saves.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for the update operation, ensuring ID and input data correctness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Vacancy records identified by IDs, verifies existence, performs deletion, and returns affected IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rule that checks IDs are provided in an array for delete operation.
